$comment: Candidates for the nearest-Pantone column of the print table: a subset of PANTONE Solid Coated (C) inks, chosen to cover the brand palette, each with its sRGB screen approximation as Pantone publishes it (Pantone Connect). Screen values only approximate a printed ink, so every match is 'nearest match, verify before printing' against a physical swatch book. To consider another ink, add it here and run `npm run build`. Cross-checked in #15 against an open dataset (npm `pantone-colors` 1.0.3, which uses pre-2010 Pantone values): 38 of these 47 inks appear there, all within ΔE2000 7.7 and most under 4, with the larger gaps matching Pantone's 2010 reformulation. Not in that dataset, so still unchecked: Black 6 C, 7408 C, 7461 C, 7466 C, 7472 C, 7541 C, 7549 C, 7687 C, Cool Gray 1 C. Before a print run, check the inks the table uses against Pantone Connect.
